full_judgment: 4. The plaintiffs' case is that the property in schedule 1 and 2 belonged to Bacha Mia, Karam Ali, Abdul Ali, Ahmed Ali, Keramat Ali and Abdur Rahman. The property in Schedule 3 belonged to Abdur Rahman alone. The C.S. and R.S. khatian has been prepared accordingly. Abdur Rahman died leaving son Kabir Ahmed and daughter Hazera Khatun Bacha Mia died leaving brother Karam Ali as his sole heir. Abdul Ali died leaving brother Bacha and Karam Ali. Kabir Ahmed sold 5 panda land to Md. Suleman in 3 plots, but possession was given in one plot. Suleman sold to Faizur Rahman. Defendant Nos. 7-13, being heirs of Faizur Rahman, are possessing the sold land Karam Ali died leaving his sister Umeda Khatun who sold her entire share of the suit property to the plaintiffs by executing 3 kabalas and delivered possession to them and thus the plaintiffs own and have been possessing 5 kanis, 3 ganda and 3 kara and the defendant Nos. 7-13 own and have been possessing 10 ganda land in the suit property. The other defendants have no title, interest or possession in the suit property. Defendant No. 1 Abdul Khaleque is the son of Torafuddin who is the ex-landlord: the defendant No. 2 is his wife. Plaintiff Nos. 1-5 filed Other Suit No. 33 of 68 for injunction and got decree. They filed Other Suit No. 141 of 69 and got decree. The plaintiffs came to know about rent .decree and auction sale in Rent Execution Case No. 937 of 1944 only when Mosharraf Ali filed documents in Other Suit No. 33 of 68. The auction sale in Rent Execution Case No. 937 of 1944 and the decrees are all void and inoperative on account of non-service of summons and notices upon the parties and thus the plaintiffs prayed for declaration that the rent decree is void and the defendant Nos. 1-6 and 14-25 have no title in the suit property and also prayed for partition of the suit property.
